base_creation_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: complete FULLY BUILT NOXUS town-screen DESIGN PROPOSAL for original Heroes of Might and Magic III. Create ONE coherent fully designed Noxian imperial urban district as a late-1990s richly textured PAINTED2D matte town screen, no interface or labels. Wide 800:374 aspect ratio. Low theatrical three-quarter slightly elevated-eye view; front-facing readable doors and roofs; elevated horizon. Ground view not an aerial/isometric grid. All architecture already composed together with streets and background, not isolated catalogue buildings. Black and charcoal masonry, battered iron, crimson cloth, deep smoky red sky, distant ash cliffs and a monumental ancestral bastion silhouette for context, localized amber forge/brazier/window light with readable shadow detail. Dark Noxian feeling but no black crushed silhouettes, no lava sea, no gothic horror cathedral substitution. Near framing buildings painted larger; naturally large rear civic/bastion architecture still substantial. Entire body outlines/eaves/chimneys/flags sit within canvas with margin, no clipped functional rooftops. Shared masonry material, continuous irregular worn paved lanes/plazas, sewer grilles, carts, service entrances, tiny workers and incidental dense attached houses make a real lived-in fortified CITY. Full building footprints have their own level supported landings and visible contact shadows; no stairs underneath any foundation, no disconnected pavement patches, roads must meet real frontal doors. Stairs ONLY connect levels between separate landing aprons. No water in buildable district.
Full distinct site plan across depth: REAR largest Imperial Seat with broad squat black-stone civic roof, triple vertical crimson standards and visible wide forward entrance at central upper third; strong rear-right Noxian Bastion gate/keep on its own level plateau; upper-left War College four-tier austere study tower with crimson slit windows; rear-left side clandestine Black Rose Academy manor separate from a small hidden Binding Vault entrance, subtle rose/ward motifs. Mid-left monumental open oval Arena of Valor, with clear internal sand arena; adjacent smaller Minotaur Reckoning pit as separate training courtyard. Mid-center Trifarian Hall as broad heavy military guild hall opening onto connected plaza. Mid-right Crimson Citadel storehouse separate from smaller Crimson Circlehouse with faint blood-red light, not another castle. Lower-mid-left Veterans' Barracks with open mustering forecourt, adjacent distinct Master Knife Yard long low guild frontage and knife targets. Lower-mid-right armored Drake-Hound pens and separate Brood Sentry arachnoid walled enclosure, recognizable protected working yards with handler access, no giant monster centerpiece. Low-right Greater Binding Vault demonic warding chamber as small black iron reinforced shrine, no recruitable unique Atakhan giant. FOREGROUND left Legion Tavern block with warmly lit doors and small civilian lodgings, foreground left-center Campaign Market with tents beside primary winding avenue. Foreground right Legion Armory forge with glowing forge window and service apron. A small earned three-principles standard monument in central plaza is an ornament, not another high tower. These 18 functional sites plus monument must have distinct readable roofs/enclosures and not overlap each other's complete opaque silhouettes. Make a real coherent asymmetric Noxian street network, not terrace rows of miniature unrelated castles. Paint recognizable national Noxus crest on selected large crimson/pale cloth standards: broad paired hooked axe-like lobes framing two upper openings, angular center and long split tapered lower blades; not a trident, bird, fleur-de-lis or generic rose. Black Rose marks confined to clandestine institution. No modern logo, no typography, no UI. Painted2D not 3D, not photoreal render, not neon toy/mobile art. One complete source composition; future layer precision requires human review.
